data.narrative:
Distributed Spectrum is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $25M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers across the sector—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic—representing a mix of Seed and Series A stages.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $25M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $62M. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector comparables—including UFORCE ($1.0B at Seed), Stark Defence ($4.0B at Series A), Castelion ($1.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M)—produces a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range of $125M to $4.0B.

The triangulation of these two methods supports a valuation range of $53M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median estimate of $531M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around stage and sector positioning: Distributed Spectrum's current valuation relative to peer financing history and the heterogeneity within Defense & Security comps create meaningful variance. The gap between stage-progression ($62M) and peer-median ($1.0B) suggests reliance on comparable company fundamentals and recent funding multiples to narrow the range.
